name: Tago Health (formerly BentoLabs AI)
long_description:
Tago Health builds AI agents for the billing back office of US healthcare providers. The agents work denials and A/R as teammates for your billing team.

When a claim is denied or underpaid, Tago's agents find out why, fix what went wrong, and draft and submit the appeal. A voice agent calls the payer and keeps following up until payment posts.

Your team approves the judgment calls, and every action is logged against the claim. Tago learns from every fix, so the same denial doesn't trip you up twice.

What Tago works on: denied claims and appeals, underpaid claims, claims with no response, aged A/R, and payer calls and follow-up.

Tago works inside your practice management system, clearinghouse and payer portals. No new logins, no migration, and we handle the setup.

Built for billing and revenue cycle teams, in-house or outsourced: providers and practices, physician groups, MSOs and RCM companies.

Trust Center: trust.tagohealth.com
one_liner: AI agents for healthcare denials and accounts receivable
